title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Records of Cancelled Bookings
content:
A booking cancellation reaches a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record only in narrow circumstances.

## Clause

Cancellation of the booking cancels the record provided that, at that point, free time on the record is running and no clock-stopping movement appears in the recorded movements. The cancellation itself carries no charge. A free-time product previously purchased for the record remains charged, since purchased products are never refunded.

Once the container has been collected empty or has been discharged, the record can no longer be cancelled. Such a record goes on being timed until each clock meets its stopping movement, and its charges are then billed in the usual way.

On cancellation the record shows cancelled, with the cancellation date recorded as its closing date.

## Cases

| Record at the time the booking is cancelled | Outcome |
|---|---|
| free time running, no clock-stopping movement recorded, container neither picked up empty nor discharged | cancelled, no charge |
| same, but an upgrade had been bought | cancelled; the upgrade charge stays on the record |
| container already picked up empty | not cancelled; timing continues to the stopping movements and the charges are billed as usual |
| container already discharged | not cancelled; timing continues to the stopping movements and the charges are billed as usual |

**Q: Does cancellation refund a free-time product bought earlier for the container?**
No. The purchase remains charged.
